Name: Greek Salad
Description: Fresh Mediterranean salad with crisp vegetables, olives, and creamy feta cheese.

Steps.Instruction: Cut cucumbers and tomatoes into large chunks.
Slice red onion into thin half-moons.
Combine vegetables in a large bowl with olives.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently.
Top with large pieces of feta cheese.
Let sit for 5 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.

Name: Kung Pao Chicken
Description: Spicy Sichuan stir-fry with tender chicken, peanuts, and dried chilies in savory sauce.

Steps.Instruction: Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes. Marinate with 1 tbsp soy sauce and cornstarch.
Mix remaining soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil for the sauce.
Heat wok over high heat. Toast Sichuan peppercorns briefly, then set aside.
Stir-fry chicken until golden, about 5 minutes. Remove from wok.
Add dried chilies, garlic, and ginger. Stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Return chicken to wok. Add sauce and peanuts.
Toss until sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve over rice.

Name: Miso Ramen
Description: Hearty Japanese noodle soup with rich miso broth, tender chashu pork, and soft-boiled egg.

Steps.Instruction: Braise pork belly in soy sauce, sake, and water for 2 hours until tender.
Soft-boil eggs for 7 minutes, then marinate in soy sauce mixture.
Heat chicken broth and whisk in miso paste until dissolved.
Add sesame oil and adjust seasoning with more soy sauce if needed.
Cook ramen noodles according to package directions.
Slice chashu pork into 1/4-inch thick pieces.
Divide noodles among bowls, ladle hot broth over them.
Top with sliced pork, halved egg, corn, nori, and sliced green onions.

Name: Pad Thai
Description: Classic Thai stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, tofu, peanuts, and tangy tamarind sauce.

Steps.Instruction: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 30 minutes, then drain.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and palm sugar to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry tofu until golden, set aside.
Cook shrimp until pink, about 2 minutes per side. Set aside.
Scramble eggs in the wok, then add noodles and sauce.
Toss until noodles are coated and slightly caramelized.
Add tofu, shrimp, bean sprouts, and green onions. Toss to combine.
Serve topped with crushed peanuts and lime wedges.

Name: Tiramisu
Description: Classic Italian dessert with espresso-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cream.

Steps.Instruction: Brew espresso and let cool. Mix with Kahlua.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar over double boiler until thick and pale.
Remove from heat. Fold in mascarpone and vanilla.
Whip heavy cream to stiff peaks. Fold into mascarpone mixture.
Quickly dip ladyfingers in espresso mixture. Arrange in 9x13 dish.
Spread half the mascarpone cream over ladyfingers.
Repeat with another layer of dipped ladyfingers and remaining cream.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours. Dust with cocoa powder before serving.

Name: Indian Lentils and Pasta
Description: A turmeric and cumin spiced lentil and tomato stew finished with orzo and fresh cilantro.

Ingredients.Name: garlic cloves, finely chopped (or 0.5 tsp garlic powder)

Steps.Instruction: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and cook 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in water, diced tomatoes with juice, lentils, cumin, turmeric and red pepper flakes, if desired.
Bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add pasta and cook uncovered until pasta is tender, about 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with cilantro and serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Curried Pumpkin Soup
Description: A creamy pumpkin and mushroom soup warmed with curry powder, nutmeg and a touch of honey.

Ingredients.Name: fresh or frozen chives, for garnish (optional)

Steps.Instruction: In a 4 quart or larger saucepan, saute the mushrooms and onion in margarine until tender.
Stir in the flour and curry powder until blended. Gradually add the broth.
Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Add the pumpkin, evaporated milk, honey, salt, pepper and nutmeg; heat through.
Garnish with chives if desired. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Hot Apple Orange Cider
Description: Apple juice simmered with halved oranges, cloves, allspice and cinnamon sticks for a warming spiced drink.

Steps.Instruction: In a 4 quart stock pot, add apple juice, water, halved oranges and all the spices.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours.
Strain out the spices and serve hot. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Leek and Mushroom Orzo
Description: Toasted orzo simmered in broth with sauteed leeks, mushrooms and tomato, finished with a little cream cheese.

Steps.Instruction: Saute leeks in oil in a medium skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook until soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the orzo and toast lightly, stirring frequently, for about 3 minutes.
Add broth and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is almost tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and simmer until the orzo is tender, about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cream cheese, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Serve warm.

Name: Pasta Ratatouille
Description: Provencal-style eggplant, zucchini, pepper and tomato saute served over pasta and topped with shredded cheese.

Ingredients.Name: uncooked pasta (rotini, penne or bow tie)
garlic cloves, finely chopped (or 0.5 tsp garlic powder)

Steps.Instruction: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and cook until soft.
Add bell pepper, zucchini and eggplant. Cook about 10 to 12 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes, salt, pepper and basil. Cook another 2 to 4 minutes or until heated through.
Serve over pasta and top with cheese. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Hummus with Tahini
Description: A quick blender dip of chickpeas, lemon juice, garlic and tahini, served in 2 tablespoon portions.

Ingredients.Name: canned garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed

Steps.Instruction: Place all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until it reaches the consistency you like: longer for a smooth dip, less for a chunky one.
If the hummus seems too thick, add 2 teaspoons of water and blend again.
No blender: mash the beans well with a fork on a large plate, then mix in the other ingredients.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Mushroom Bulgur Pilaf
Description: Toasted bulgur cooked in broth with browned mushrooms and onion, then tossed with fresh spinach.

Steps.Instruction: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, saute onion in oil until softened.
Add mushrooms and saute until beginning to brown, stirring often. Stir in bulgur and keep stirring until browned.
Add broth, garlic powder and pepper. Cover, reduce heat to low and cook 15 to 20 minutes, until bulgur is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat, mix in the spinach and serve. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Grilled Tuna with Chickpea and Spinach Salad
Description: Lemon, garlic and oregano marinated tuna steaks grilled and served over a chickpea, spinach and tomato salad.

Ingredients.Name: low-sodium canned chickpeas, drained and rinsed (half a 15.5 oz can)
leaf spinach, rinsed and dried (half a 10 oz bag)

Steps.Instruction: Preheat a grill pan or oven broiler, with the rack 3 inches from the heat, on high.
Combine oil, garlic, 2 tablespoons lemon juice and oregano, and brush over the tuna steaks. Marinate 5 to 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine all salad ingredients. The salad can be made up to 2 hours ahead and refrigerated.
Grill or broil tuna on high heat 3 to 4 minutes per side, until opaque and it separates easily with a fork (145 degrees F).
Serve one tuna steak over 1 cup of the salad.

Name: Beef and Broccoli
Description: Ground beef and broccoli in a ginger, garlic and sesame soy sauce, served over bulgur.

Steps.Instruction: Cook beef, ginger and garlic powder in a skillet over medium-high heat until the meat is browned.
In a medium bowl, mix brown sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, pepper flakes and water.
Add the sauce to the beef and cook for 5 minutes. Add broccoli and cook until tender.
Serve over cooked bulgur. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Steamed Chicken Wontons
Description: Hand-folded wontons filled with spiced ground chicken, cabbage and carrot, steamed until tender.

Ingredients.Name: water or egg white, for sealing the edges

Steps.Instruction: Combine green onion, spices, cornstarch and sesame oil in a large bowl.
Add the cooked chicken, cabbage and carrot. Mix well.
Place 1 tablespoon of filling in the center of each wonton wrapper and brush the edges with water or egg white.
Fold each wrapper diagonally so the corners line up and press the edges to seal. Bring the two side corners together over the filling and pinch to close.
Spray a steamer basket with nonstick spray. Add wontons so they do not touch, cover and steam over simmering water 6 to 7 minutes.

Name: Garlic Ginger Ramen with Beef
Description: A one-skillet weeknight ramen with browned beef, mixed vegetables, garlic and fresh ginger.

Ingredients.Name: packages soy sauce flavor instant ramen noodles, broken up (use 1 seasoning packet)
fresh ginger, grated (or 0.25 tsp ground ginger)
garlic cloves, minced (or 0.5 tsp garlic powder)

Steps.Instruction: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the ground beef until no longer pink. Drain the fat.
Add 2 cups water and one seasoning packet to the beef and mix well.
Add frozen vegetables, green onion, ginger and garlic and bring to a boil over high heat.
Add the ramen noodles, reduce heat to low and simmer 3 to 5 minutes until the vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.

Name: Chicken Mole
Description: Whole chicken simmered until tender, then finished in a chili, cocoa and peanut butter mole sauce.

Ingredients.Name: whole chicken, cut into pieces, skin and fat removed
garlic cloves, chopped (or 1 tsp garlic powder)
chili powder or ground chile powder

Steps.Instruction: Cut the chicken into thighs, legs, breast, wings and back. Remove skin and fat from all but the wings and back, and cut breast pieces in half.
In a large pot, combine chicken, onion, garlic and 4.5 cups water. Boil, then simmer on low 30 minutes, until cooked through (165 degrees F).
Meanwhile, mix chili powder, oregano, cocoa, flour, sugar, salt and pepper. Stir in the remaining 0.5 cup water until smooth, then stir in peanut butter.
Move the cooked chicken to a bowl. Slowly whisk the seasoning mix into the broth, bring to a boil, then cook on medium-low 15 minutes or until thickened.
Return the chicken to the pot, whole or shredded, and heat through. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Pozole with Chicken
Description: A quick red chile and hominy soup with shredded chicken, topped with cabbage, radish, lime and cilantro.

Ingredients.Name: garlic cloves, minced (or 0.5 tsp garlic powder)
canned red chile sauce (or 8 oz tomato sauce plus 2 to 4 Tbsp chili powder)
toppings: shredded cabbage, sliced radish, chopped onion, lime juice, cilantro, avocado (optional)

Steps.Instruction: In a large saucepan on medium heat, saute onion in oil until it begins to soften, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add the chile sauce, broth, cumin, oregano and hominy and bring to a boil, stirring.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes. Stir in the chicken and heat through, about 2 minutes.
Spoon into shallow bowls and add toppings as desired. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Minestrone Soup
Description: A hearty vegetable, kidney bean and macaroni soup simmered in a basil-scented tomato broth.

Ingredients.Name: canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed

Steps.Instruction: In a 5 quart saucepan over medium heat, cook onion, celery and carrot in oil, stirring, until the onion is soft but not browned.
Add potato, tomatoes, broth, beans and basil.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add macaroni and zucchini and simmer another 15 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Classic Honey Flan
Description: Light baked custards sweetened with honey and lemon zest, set over a honey-cinnamon base and inverted to serve.

Steps.Instruction: Preheat oven to 325 degrees F. Spray four ovenproof custard cups with nonstick spray. Bring water to a boil for the water bath.
In a bowl, beat the egg, egg substitute, milk, 0.25 cup plus 1 Tbsp honey, lemon zest and vanilla until mixed but not foamy.
In a separate bowl, blend the remaining 2 Tbsp honey with the cinnamon.
Set the cups in a large baking dish. Spoon 0.5 Tbsp honey-cinnamon into each cup, then divide the egg mixture among them.
Place on the middle oven rack and pour boiling water into the dish to a depth of 1 inch. Bake 45 minutes, until a knife comes out clean.
Serve warm or cold: loosen the edges with a knife and invert onto dessert plates.

Name: Buttermilk Scones
Description: Drop-style whole wheat and buttermilk scones studded with raisins, baked until well browned.

Steps.Instruction: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
Combine whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl. Mix well.
Add raisins and mix lightly.
In a small bowl, combine melted butter and buttermilk. Add to the flour mixture and mix gently.
Spoon the dough into 9 equal mounds on a greased baking sheet.
Bake until well browned, 18 to 20 minutes. Serve hot or at room temperature, ideally the same day.

Name: Cherry Puff Pancake
Description: An oven-baked puffed pancake poured over sweet cherries in a hot buttered skillet and sprinkled with almonds.

Ingredients.Name: sweet cherries, halved and pitted (fresh or thawed frozen)

Steps.Instruction: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F.
In a medium bowl or blender, beat the eggs, milk and vanilla until well blended.
Mix the flour, sugar and cinnamon, add to the liquid ingredients and mix until there are no lumps.
Melt the butter in a 10 or 11 inch ovenproof skillet in the hot oven until bubbly. Remove and quickly spread the cherries over the bottom.
Pour the batter over the cherries and sprinkle with almonds, if using.
Bake 15 to 20 minutes, until the edges are browned and the center is golden. Cool slightly and cut into 4 pieces.

Name: Oven Baked Salmon
Description: Simple salmon fillets drizzled with oil, seasoned with salt and pepper, and roasted in a hot oven.

Ingredients.Name: fresh or thawed salmon (12 to 16 oz), cut into 3 or 4 pieces

Steps.Instruction: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F.
Place the salmon skin side down on a foil-lined baking pan. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake 10 to 15 minutes depending on thickness, until the fish is opaque and flakes with a fork (145 degrees F in the center).
Serve skin side down. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Ham and Vegetable Chowder
Description: A creamy-style chowder of cabbage, potato, cream-style corn and lean ham, topped with cheddar.

Steps.Instruction: Heat oil in a 4 quart or larger saucepan. Saute onion, cabbage and potato over medium heat until soft, about 10 minutes, stirring often.
Add chicken broth, corn, ham and pepper.
Cover and simmer until the potato is tender, about 10 minutes.
Serve hot, sprinkled with cheese. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Quick Tomato Pasta Sauce
Description: A 20 minute pantry tomato sauce with garlic, lemon and a pinch of red pepper for pasta or recipes.

Ingredients.Name: garlic cloves, minced (or 0.5 tsp garlic powder)

Steps.Instruction: In a medium saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. If using garlic powder, skip the oil and this step.
Add tomatoes, lemon juice, salt, pepper and red pepper flakes, if desired. Cook until heated through, stirring occasionally.
For a thicker sauce, cook 10 to 20 minutes more so the liquid can evaporate.
Serve over pasta or use in any recipe calling for pasta sauce. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

Name: Stir-Fry Noodles with Peanut Sauce
Description: Ramen noodles tossed with chicken, carrots and cabbage in a spicy ginger peanut butter and soy sauce.

Ingredients.Name: ramen-style noodles (two 3 oz packages, flavor packets discarded)
boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut in thin strips
fresh ginger, finely chopped (or 0.5 tsp ground)
cabbage, thinly sliced (half a large head)

Steps.Instruction: Bring 4 cups water to a boil in a 2 to 3 quart saucepan. Add the noodles without flavor packets, cover and remove from heat. Wait 1 minute, drain and set aside.
In a small saucepan, combine peanut butter, soy sauce and 0.5 cup water. Heat on low, stirring until smooth. Remove from heat.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink when cut, 3 to 5 minutes.
Add red pepper, ginger and carrots and cook 2 to 3 minutes. Add cabbage and cook 3 to 4 minutes, until crisp-tender.
Stir in green onion, noodles and peanut sauce. Toss and serve right away.

Name: Cucumber Yogurt Dip
Description: A tzatziki-style dip of yogurt, grated cucumber, dill, lemon and garlic served with fresh vegetables.

Steps.Instruction: Peel, seed and grate one cucumber. Slice the other cucumber and set aside.
Mix the yogurt, grated cucumber, sour cream, lemon juice, dill and garlic in a serving bowl. Chill for 1 hour.
Arrange the sliced cucumber, tomatoes, broccoli and carrots on a platter and serve with the dip.
For gyros, spoon the dip into whole wheat pitas with grilled chicken or beef, onion, tomato and lettuce.

Name: Grilled Lamb Salad
Description: Soy and rice vinegar marinated lamb skewers grilled and tossed with a crunchy cabbage, carrot and sesame slaw.

Ingredients.Name: boneless leg of lamb, cut into 1 inch cubes
Savoy, Napa or green cabbage, shredded

Steps.Instruction: Mix the sugar, rice vinegar, soy sauce, water and oil for the marinade and dressing; divide evenly in two.
Place the lamb in a glass dish, pour half of the marinade over it, cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours.
In a large bowl, toss the cabbage, carrots, jicama if using, green onions and sesame seeds. Soak the skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the marinade (discard it) and thread onto the 4 skewers. Grill 5 to 6 minutes per side, to 145 degrees F for medium-rare.
Remove the lamb from the skewers, toss with the salad, divide among 4 plates and drizzle with the remaining dressing.

Name: Garlic Bok Choy
Description: Bok choy quickly stir-fried with plenty of garlic until the greens wilt and the stems are tender-crisp.

Ingredients.Name: garlic cloves, minced (4 to 6, or 1 to 1.5 tsp garlic powder)

Steps.Instruction: Cut the bok choy crosswise into easy-to-eat pieces.
In a medium skillet over medium-high heat, saute the garlic in oil until fragrant. If using garlic powder, add it with the salt in the next step.
Add the bok choy and stir quickly. Add salt.
Stir until the greens are wilted and the stems are tender-crisp. Serve hot.

Name: Quinoa Salad
Description: Chilled quinoa tossed with carrot, celery, red pepper, green onion and parsley in a light garlic rice vinegar dressing.

Ingredients.Name: garlic cloves, finely chopped (or 0.5 tsp garlic powder)

Steps.Instruction: Rinse the quinoa in a fine-mesh strainer under running water for 1 minute.
Bring the water or broth and quinoa to a boil in a 2 to 3 quart saucepan. Lower the heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes. Refrigerate until cool.
While the quinoa cools, combine all the vegetables in a salad bowl.
In a small jar with a tight lid, shake together the rice vinegar, water, oil and garlic. Add to the vegetables.
Add the quinoa and stir gently to combine. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
